mistake_reason: At step 12, FileSurfer withheld a critical CATEGORIES element ('Soups and Stews') that was present in the XML and instead provided a filtered list omitting that entry. This information withholding (FM-2.4) misled the team into believing there was no soups-related category, causing a misclassification of the unique food (Gazpacho) under 'Beverages' rather than 'Soups and Stews'. Subsequent confirmations (steps 15 and 19) continued to conceal the presence of 'Soups and Stews', reinforcing the error and leading to the wrong final answer.
